behaviour: Styles of the pages tab bar for desktop footer and mobile bottom bar, light and dark.
rules: Root .pages-tab-bar inside `.excalidraw`: flex row, align-items center, gap 0.25rem, max-width min(60vw, 40rem), overflow-x auto, scrollbar-width none, pointer-events var(--ui-pointerEvents), padding 0.25rem, background var(--island-bg-color), border-radius var(--border-radius-lg), box-shadow var(--shadow-island).
Modifier .pages-tab-bar--mobile: max-width 100%, margin-bottom 0.5rem.

.pages-tab-bar__tab: inline-flex, height 2rem, padding 0 0.5rem, border 1px solid transparent, border-radius var(--border-radius-md), background transparent, color var(--text-primary-color), font-size 0.875rem, white-space nowrap, cursor pointer; :hover background var(--button-hover-bg); :focus-visible outline 2px solid var(--color-primary).
.pages-tab-bar__tab--active (and [aria-selected="true"]): background var(--color-primary-light), color var(--color-primary-darker), font-weight 600.
.pages-tab-bar__tab--drop-target: border-inline-start 2px solid var(--color-primary).

.pages-tab-bar__rename-input: height 1.75rem, width 8rem, font-size 0.875rem, border 1px solid var(--color-primary), border-radius var(--border-radius-md), background var(--input-bg-color), color var(--text-primary-color).
.pages-tab-bar__add and .pages-tab-bar__menu-trigger: 2rem square icon buttons, transparent background, :hover var(--button-hover-bg), svg width 1rem.
Dark theme: `.excalidraw.theme--dark .pages-tab-bar__tab--active` uses color var(--color-primary-light-darker) and background var(--color-primary-darkest).

behaviour: Tab bar listing the drawing's pages with switch, add, inline rename, drag reorder and a per-page menu.
rules: Reads appState via useUIAppState(), app via useApp(), actionManager via useExcalidrawActionManager(); pages come from getVisiblePages(appState.pages).
Returns null when appState.zenModeEnabled or app.props.UIOptions.pages === false.
Props: { isMobile?: boolean }; root <div className={clsx("pages-tab-bar", {"pages-tab-bar--mobile": isMobile})} role="tablist" aria-label={t("pages.title")} data-testid="pages-tab-bar">.

Each page renders a <button type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={active} tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1} data-testid={`page-tab-${page.id}`} className pages-tab-bar__tab (+ --active)>{page.name}</button>; click runs actionManager.executeAction(actionSwitchPage, "ui", page.id).
Keyboard on a tab: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus to the previous/next tab and switch to it; Enter or F2 starts rename (edit mode only); Delete does nothing (delete is in the menu).

Rename (edit mode only, i.e. !appState.viewModeEnabled): double-click or the menu entry replaces the tab with <input className="pages-tab-bar__rename-input" aria-label={t("pages.pageName")} data-testid="page-rename-input" autoFocus> holding the name; Enter commits via actionRenamePage {pageId, name: value}, Escape cancels, blur commits; an empty or whitespace name leaves the old name (the action rejects it).

Drag reorder (edit mode only): tabs are draggable; dragstart stores the page id in a ref and sets dataTransfer data "text/plain"; dragover on another tab calls preventDefault and marks it --drop-target; drop runs actionMovePage {pageId: dragged, toIndex: index of the target tab among the visible pages without the dragged page}; dragend clears state.

Menu (edit mode only): a DropdownMenu (../dropdownMenu/DropdownMenu) with a trigger button className pages-tab-bar__menu-trigger aria-label={t("pages.pageMenu")} data-testid="pages-menu-trigger" (icon DotsHorizontalIcon) for the active page; open state is local useState; items: rename (data-testid page-menu-rename), move left (page-menu-move-left, disabled when first), move right (page-menu-move-right, disabled when last), delete (page-menu-delete, icon TrashIcon, disabled when only one page); move/delete run actionMovePageLeft/actionMovePageRight/actionDeletePage with the active page id via executeAction(action, "ui", pageId); onClickOutside closes the menu.

Add button (edit mode only): <button className="pages-tab-bar__add" aria-label={t("pages.addPage")} title={t("pages.addPage")} data-testid="pages-add-button"> with PlusIcon running actionAddPage via executeAction(actionAddPage, "ui").
The active tab scrolls into view (scrollIntoView({block: "nearest", inline: "nearest"})) when activePageId changes; guard for jsdom where scrollIntoView may be missing.
Use app.ownerDocument where DOM access is needed; set PagesTabBar.displayName = "PagesTabBar"; export as named and default.
